failures.criterion: The timers the plan keeps are jittered every period (plan decision 8: the delivery reconcile, the architecture ticker and the redelivery sweep 'each now jittered every period'; section 1a lists the redelivery sweep among RunJittered's callers)
failures.evidence: internal/dispatch/redeliver/sweep.go:246 at the head is still `ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)`, and the main.go loop comment says 'the webhook redelivery sweep every 2 minutes, on a plain ticker'. Measured with two head processes started together: their webhook-redelivery lease attempts fell 16-19 ms apart in each of five consecutive 2-minute periods (16:28:21.428/.447, 16:30:21.429/.447, 16:32:21.433/.449, 16:34:21.430/.445, 16:36:21.430/.445). Over the same window the jittered delivery reconcile and architecture import drifted apart. INFRA-627's spec (the split-out 2i) covers only the pending.<GUID> index and does not carry the jitter, so neither change does. Fix: run the sweep's loop on duty.RunJittered as the other two timers do, or have the architect record the departure. No red test: a test of the wait would pin which helper the loop calls, and the plan's jitter test already covers RunJittered.

failures.criterion: Each keepalive or lease renewal the plan kept is named in the PR body with its period and why no event can replace it (INFRA-514 architect, 16:16Z)
failures.evidence: The body's Change line names only 'the kept timers (delivery reconcile, architecture import) are jittered every period', and the proof line gives only '+2/min' for the shared listener's keep-alive. The body does not name these: the shared wake listener's 30 s ping (pglisten DefaultListenIdle, the only way to notice a dead LISTEN connection, since a dead connection receives no notification); the webhook redelivery sweep every 2 min (GitHub has no feed of failed deliveries); the standby intake's 2 s bind poll and its consumer-lease reconcile every 30 s per durable (76 statements per 10 min over two processes; NATS gives no event when the durable's holder goes away); and plan decision 9's out-of-scope floor (outbox retry ticker 5 s, settlement resumption 1 min, per-feature listener pings 30 s). The body also has stale text. Its NOTIFY-site note cites migrations 0121, 0123 and 0126, which are now 0136, 0138 and 0141. Its INFRA-558 note gives `StopDelivering()`, which is now `StopDelivering(ctx)`. Its 'Proven by' idle figure, 2.81 -> 2.32 statements/s, was measured at bead55d4: at d47dbf05 and c83c0851 the measured idle is 4.55 -> 4.21 per process, because main added a 5 s server-process heartbeat (#2390) and a 5 s edit-notice sweep (#2137). Breakdown: dispatch://INFRA-607/artifact/idle-breakdown-round-4-md.
